intro: From April 22 to August 3, 2026, ZCyberNews published 16 articles tagged Unit 42, covering 13 high-severity and 1 critical incident. Threat actors CL-STA-1062, Gremlin Stealer, and LockBit were observed across technology, software development, enterprise, financial services, and government sectors. Reported activity spanned Global, Central America, North America, South America, and South Asia regions. These reports detail tactics and indicators associated with each distinct actor, providing security teams with actionable intelligence for defense and detection.
